ns2:course.label: Junior Planning Workshop
ns2:course.description: Provides students with an opportunity to further develop planning skills and knowledge to prepare for an advanced level urban planning workshop. Students will work in small groups to define and solve planning problems as they improve skills in data collection and analysis, mapping and spatial analysis, design, oral and written communication and presentation, public engagement, teamwork, and consensus building. Specific projects associated with the workshop will vary from year to year. Prerequisite: UP 312. Intended for juniors in the Department of Urban and Regional Planning.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: UP 312. Intended for juniors in the Department of Urban and Regional Planning.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
